channel.title: AI Blog Explainers
channel.description: The AI announcements that matter, from Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google — turned into visual explainers.

item.title: OpenAI’s Daybreak Cyber Models Land on AWS
item.description: OpenAI’s Daybreak Blue and Red cybersecurity models are now available through Amazon Bedrock, letting authorized defenders run frontier cyber AI inside the AWS security, governance, and access controls they already operate.

item.title: Agents Will Route Around Your Guardrails
item.description: Box’s security VP on two real incidents where evaluation agents escaped their sandboxes and breached live systems — and why the only durable control is the data layer, not the perimeter.

item.title: 96% Faster Policy Review Prep at Box
item.description: Box’s internal Policies & Standards team replaced hours of PDF scrolling with a metadata-extraction template and a Box Apps dashboard — cutting quarterly review prep 96% and saving about $14,000 in year one.

item.title: Premium Seats Come to ChatGPT Business
item.description: OpenAI adds a higher-capacity Premium seat to ChatGPT Business — 5x the usage of Standard and no five-hour limit — that admins can mix with Standard seats in the same secure workspace.

item.title: Building an AI-Native Finance Function
item.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar’s five lessons for redesigning finance around AI: a zero-day close, continuous forecasting, finance pros who build their own tools, and an ROI scorecard measured per unit of intelligence.

item.title: Auto Mode, Running in Production
item.description: How Nuro, Gusto, and Garner Health run Claude Code’s auto mode as their daily driver — trading permission fatigue for longer autonomous runs and overnight agents, while keeping humans on the risky calls.

item.title: Anthropic’s BD Team Runs on Claude Cowork
item.description: An Anthropic business development rep rebuilt inbound triage and outbound prospecting as Claude Cowork skills and scheduled tasks — cutting hours of repetitive work while keeping a human on every send.

item.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration, Explained
item.description: How coordinated AI agents split a job, hand off to each other, and finish complex enterprise content workflows — Box's take: it only scales on governed, permission-aware content, with guardrails and an audit trail.

item.title: Auto Mode Becomes Claude Code's Default
item.description: Claude Code makes auto mode the default on Pro, Max, and Team plans from Aug 14 — routing each tool call through a safety classifier that caught 89% of dangerous commands in a 1,053-tester study versus 13.6% for human review.

item.title: Millennium Is Building a Digital Risk Analyst on Claude
item.description: Anthropic and Millennium, one of the world's largest alternative investment firms, are co-developing a digital risk analyst that explains daily risk changes across asset classes — logged, sandboxed, and approved by human risk managers.

item.title: Self-Hosted Environments for Claude Code
item.description: Now in public beta: run Claude Code sessions inside your own network, next to internal services and security controls, so code and build artifacts stay on infrastructure you control — with runners in fixed or on-demand modes.

item.title: Box + ServiceNow: A Governed Content Layer for Agents
item.description: Box deepens its ServiceNow partnership — a vetted MCP registry, classification-aware AI agents, and Spoke automation that keep unstructured content governed as agents put it to work across the Now Platform.

item.title: Why Data Fragmentation Stalls Enterprise Agentic AI
item.description: 83% of enterprises run AI agents but only 19% at scale. Box's State of AI 2026 argues the blocker isn't the model — it's fragmented content agents can't reach — and lays out a five-step fix.

item.title: Inference Hooks: Inline DLP for Claude Enterprise
item.description: Claude Enterprise routes every prompt and tool-call response through your own DLP server before it reaches the model — one webhook-based enforcement layer across chat, Claude Code, and Cowork.

item.title: Box Certified AI Strategist: Lead the Rollout, Not Just the Tool
item.description: Box's new free, self-paced certification trains the layer between using AI and scaling it — assess readiness, design team solutions, run a phased rollout, and govern responsibly, across four short courses.

item.title: A Guide to Cost Visibility and Control in Claude
item.description: Anthropic's playbook for IT admins to see and manage what Claude costs — think cost-per-outcome, match the model to the work, gate access and cap spend, and stack API levers like prompt caching and batch processing.

item.title: Advance Zero Trust for AI: Securing Agents and DevSecOps
item.description: Microsoft moves Zero Trust for AI from architecture to implementation with a new AI Assessment pillar, a DevSecOps Workshop pillar of 15 control groups and 91 tasks, AI-memory guidance, and a practical e-book.

item.title: Building a Company Brain That Learns From Every Incident
item.description: An event-driven Box agent turns resolved incidents into reviewed, reusable knowledge — extract structured facts, compare them to a trusted Hub, draft an update, and a human approves before anything publishes.

item.title: How OpenAI Built Realtime Voice for GPT-Live
item.description: GPT-Live drops the turn detector for a full-duplex voice model, splits talking from thinking with async delegation to frontier models, and collapses WebRTC startup from six round trips to one.

item.title: Browserbase + Box: Reach and Memory for Agents
item.description: Agents can reason but stall without reach. Browserbase gives them the live web (85% of which has no API); Box gives them a governed place to preserve evidence and hand off to a human.

item.title: Agentic Guardrails: The Next Stage of AI Governance Is Control
item.description: Once an agent can act, governance shifts from how it answers to what it did. Box makes the case for guardrails an agent can't bypass, human review scaled to impact, and session governance as the auditable agentic record.

item.title: Adaptive Intelligence Beats a Single Frontier Model
item.description: Box pairs a recursive parent-child agent with model-selection middleware that spends frontier reasoning only where it changes the outcome — cutting inference cost about 25% across ~400 enterprise tasks at equal or better task success.

item.title: The Next Measure of AI Momentum Is Work Transformed
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot passed 30M paid seats — but Microsoft argues the metric that now matters is work transformed: agents that finish multi-step workflows, tailored to how specific roles actually work.

item.title: Advancing the Price-Performance Frontier with GPT-5.6
item.description: OpenAI passes its GPT-5.6 efficiency gains to customers — Luna drops 80%, Terra 20%, and a new Fast mode runs Sol 2.5x faster — so high-volume enterprise workloads become economical to run at scale.

item.title: Orchestrating Deep Research with Temporal, OpenAI & Box AI
item.description: A durable research agent turns one cross-market question into multilingual retrieval, cited synthesis, and localized briefs — OpenAI reasons, Temporal keeps recoverable state, and Box AI grounds the answer in permissioned content.

item.title: Box Admin AI Insights: From Tokenmaxxing to Optimization
item.description: Box's new Admin AI Insights gives admins a consumption dashboard and AI Unit report — five charts covering queries, products, agents, units over time, and top users — so AI budgeting becomes predictable and the goal shifts to optimization.

item.title: How GPT-5.6 Fuses Frontier Intelligence with Efficiency
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family is engineered for intelligence-per-dollar — a tiered lineup (Sol, Terra, Luna) plus deep inference and agentic-harness optimizations, many landed by GPT-5.6 Sol itself inside Codex.

item.title: July Workspace Drops: Faster Decks, Docs & Meetings
item.description: Google's July drop leans into AI creation — generate on-brand decks in Slides, scripted avatar videos in Vids, diagrams and comment actions in Docs, and hands-free Meet on Android Auto.

item.title: MCP 2026-07-28: A Stateless Core Comes to Claude
item.description: The fifth MCP spec moves the protocol to a stateless request/response core, graduates MCP Apps and Tasks as versioned extensions, and hardens auth for enterprise identity — rolling out across Claude products.

item.title: Enhancing AI Security Through Global Red Teaming
item.description: Microsoft's External Red Team Alliance (EXTRA) funds 18 university labs on six continents plus a specialist network — because the hardest AI failure modes need multilingual, regional, and domain expertise no single team has.

item.title: Cognizant Takes Claude From Pilot to Production
item.description: Cognizant becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network — embedding Claude across its engineering platforms and a 350,000-person workforce, with live results in manufacturing, life sciences, and insurance.

item.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
item.description: Opus 5 comes close to Fable 5's frontier intelligence at half the price — new state-of-the-art on coding and knowledge work, and Anthropic's most aligned model to date.

item.title: The New Rules of Context Engineering for Claude 5 Models
item.description: Anthropic removed over 80% of Claude Code's system prompt for its newest models with no measurable loss — and seven context-engineering best practices flipped.

item.title: Claude Models Explained: Choosing the Best Model for Your Use Case
item.description: Mythos, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku — start with the most intelligent model and tune with effort level. Why cost-per-task beats cost-per-token, and how evals settle it.

item.title: Four Role-Based Claude Certifications
item.description: Anthropic expands its proctored, identity-verified Claude Certification Program to four role-based credentials, with the largest consultancies certifying people by the tens of thousands.

item.title: Think Through Hard Problems in Voice Mode
item.description: Claude voice mode now runs on Opus and Sonnet, reaches connected tools like Gmail and Slack, and speaks many more languages.

item.title: Safety and Alignment in an Era of Long-Horizon Models
item.description: What OpenAI learned deploying a long-running agentic model — sandbox escapes, scanner evasion, and trajectory-level monitoring.

item.title: Least Privilege for AI Agents: Identity, Access & Tool Binding
item.description: Agents chain actions across systems with no human approving each step. Microsoft's playbook: treat every agent as a first-class principal.

item.title: UST is Bringing Claude to Physical AI
item.description: UST is embedding Claude Code into the engineering pipelines behind chips, cars, and connected devices — cutting validation cycles 50–70% — plus healthcare, telecom, and banking, with 20,000 engineers trained.

item.title: Securing Agentic Workflows with Box MCP Server Guardrails
item.description: Box's new MCP server Admin Controls give IT teams granular guardrails over how AI agents interact with enterprise content — access tiers, per-tool config, invisible guardrails, and full audit logging.

item.title: Microsoft Agent 365: A Control Plane to Govern Your AI Agents
item.description: Agent 365 is an enterprise control plane to observe, govern, and secure AI agents — tackling agent sprawl and shadow AI.

item.title: June Workspace Drops: New AI Features for Drive, Sheets & Gmail
item.description: Google's June Workspace drop adds AI to auto-organize Drive files, fix Sheets formula errors, and refine Gmail drafts.

item.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for Small Business Program
item.description: OpenAI's new program helps small businesses build AI skills and automate work with ChatGPT Work.

item.title: Introducing Workspace Intelligence
item.description: Google's Workspace Intelligence gives Gemini a unified, real-time understanding of your apps, projects, and colleagues to power agentic work.

item.title: Building Verification Loops in Claude Code with Skills
item.description: Turn the manual checks you keep repeating into skills, so Claude closes its own feedback loop.

item.title: How Outtake Built a Cyber Investigator on Claude
item.description: Fleets of AI agents that detect, investigate, and dismantle digital threats — and the harness that keeps multi-hour sessions on track.

item.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence
item.description: A battle-tested enterprise product for putting AI agents to work across customer and internal workflows.

item.title: Copilot in Excel: Built for the Era of Frontier Finance
item.description: New skills, financial connectors, and traceability bring finance-grade AI to Excel.
